{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] a '''genetic scientist''' designed a [[Anti-Caarite virus|deadly virus]] [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to members of the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on behalf of the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]]. To satisfy their ego, the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] marked the cellular structure of the virus at a sub-atomic level with a squiggle denoting the scientist's signature, hidden such that only the scientist could note the marking. The scientist was capable of reconfiguring the virus in a matter of [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] to modify its properties.<ref name="OA">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Open Aarms}}</ref>
